misconceptions.description: Student confuses tree height (from node to farthest leaf) with node depth (from root to node)
observable_patterns: Computes height as distance from root
Uses depth formula for height computation
Returns depth of node when height is asked
misconceptions.invariant: Depth of a node = distance from root to node. Height of a node = distance from node to its deepest descendant. Height of tree = height of root.

transfer_templates.question:
Tree:    1
        / \
       2   3
      /
     4

What is the depth of node 4? What is the height of node 2? What is the height of the tree?
transfer_templates.target_reasoning: Depth of 4 = 2 (root→2→4). Height of 2 = 1 (2→4). Height of tree = height of root = 2 (1→2→4).
